_comment: Per-game overrides applied on top of ../client-config-template.json when the release is staged. ONLY the keys that differ for this game belong here -- everything else, including the template's explanatory comments, comes from the template so there is one copy of it. dev-scripts/stage-release.ps1 applies these.
_comment_interp: 175ms rather than the template's 250ms. Chosen by the user on 2026-08-28 after a render-knob sweep against meshghost-netsim's simulated bad link: 200ms was 'noticable unless i looked for it', 175ms 'didn't see anything at all', and 150ms 'living at the edge where its noticable sometimes'. TEVI is the ONLY adapter this has been measured for -- Pseudoregalia, Emerald and Crystal have never been netsim-tested for interp and keep the template's 250ms until they are. See agent_docs/verified.md and ADR 0040. 2026-09-01: default RAISED to 300ms, the user's call -- that sweep's link was same-continent grade, and the default should survive an EU<->NA-grade link like Pseudoregalia's now does. 300ms is an ASSUMPTION extrapolated from Pseudoregalia's measured 250->375ms on the ocean-profile rig (the link's wobble costs milliseconds, not percent, so 175+125), never watched on TEVI; the reasoning for guessing a DEFAULT is that a too-high interp only adds delay, never stutter, so the guess cannot regress smoothness. The measured 175ms stays the documented floor for good same-continent links (README.txt).
_comment_ghost_collision: Disabled because in TEVI it is not a choice: the ghost is a clone of the player's visual object with every Collider2D and Rigidbody2D stripped off it at creation (Plugin.cs), so it cannot be solid by construction, and this adapter does not handle the session_policy message at all. Shipping the template's enabled would advertise a switch that does nothing -- the same trap local_game_bridge was until 2026-08-28. The user's position, same day: TEVI has no collision on the player and most likely never will. If that ever changes, this becomes a real setting and the adapter has to start honouring session_policy.
